traps.summary: Current code marks the shipment ready before ERP acknowledgement.
At-least-once delivery has no defined idempotency mechanism.
A timeout may be an accepted request, but retry behavior is not defined for that ambiguity.
The process after the third failed attempt and its business owner are missing.
The business outcome for partially accepted orders is missing.
Cancellation while an ERP request is in flight has no reconciliation rule.
